top_signals.title: Japan’s Inflation Paradox Is Creating Winners and Losers
top_signals.summary: Rising prices are fueling a backlash against the government even as they signal a new era of economic dynamism after years of deflation. Bloomberg's Shery Ahn has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Mexico Has More Refining Capacity. So Why Are Fuel Imports Rising?
top_signals.summary: Mexico’s push for fuel self-sufficiency has run into a stubborn problem: Pemex has built and upgraded refining capacity faster than it has learned to operate it reliably. The state oil company is being asked to send more crude into domestic refineries and less onto the export market, a strategy that looks increasingly sensible when refined products’ cracks are strong. But the second quarter of 2026 showed the weakness of that model. Mexican refineries processed only around 1 million b/d (58% of installed capacity), while fuel imports…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan sees 60% rise in passport applications in July
top_signals.summary: There were about 3.3 times more applications in the first three days of July compared with the same period last year, a Foreign Ministry official said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Flock tightens privacy controls amid scandals over officer abuse
top_signals.summary: All Flock Safety customers will be required to adopt its "Audit Assistance" feature for tracking abnormal uses, and the company says it will hold license plate data for only seven days in most cases.
